d: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's N.O.V.A 2
ld: N.O.V.A. 2 is Gameloft's sci-fi first-person shooter, originally released for Android as NOVA-2-HD-v1-0-5.apk (package com.gameloft.android.GAND.GloftN2HP). This port runs the compiled native library (libnova2.so, armeabi-v7a) from the Android release directly on the PS Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 processor, using a dynamic loader (soloader) and an Android environment emulation layer (FalsoJNI), with vitaGL providing the GLES 2.0 rendering backend.
req:
- A PS Vita / PS TV on Custom Firmware (HENkaku / h-encore / Enso), 3.60-3.74.
- kubridge and FdFix installed as kernel plugins (ur0:tai/config.txt under *KERNEL).
- libshacccg.suprx installed in ur0:data/ (extraction guide).
